title: Use the supported SDK transport seam with a detached HTTP message
trigger: SDK provider transport injected HttpClient already sent message physical attempt retries
guidance: Google.GenAI 1.6.1 constructs a private HTTP client and cannot qualify injected observation or redirect control. The pinned 1.13.0 ClientOptions.HttpClientFactory supplies the supported seam. An SDK HTTP request must be detached before sending it through another HttpClient because .NET marks the original SDK message already sent. Copy method, URI, HTTP version policy, headers and exact body bytes; retain response fields before SDK deserialization. Guard the per-invocation handler against a second inference send and qualify retryable429/503 statuses with counted offline transport fixtures. The host remains responsible for injected inner handler chains and durable admission.

One SDK SendAsync per request method; supported client factory exists in matching ApiClient source.
